塞吉·布罗什（Serge Bloch）
1956年出生于法国，是法国当红视觉设计者、插画家和艺术总监，创作领域涵盖童书和大众出版。在超过三十年的插画生涯中，布勒奇说：“我最喜欢的作品是《我等待》”。
除了绘本，他也和美国多家媒体如《纽约时报》、《时代》杂志和《国家地理》杂志合作插画。塞吉·布罗什目前旅居美国纽约。
获奖纪录：2005年度国际插画家协会奖；2005年法国巴欧巴BAOBAB童书奖；2007年意大利波隆那童书插画奖。
page_text_en:
Serge Bloch
Born in 1956 in France, he is a prominent French visual designer, illustrator, and art director, whose creative work spans children's books and general publishing. In over thirty years of illustration, Bloch said: "My favorite work is 'I Wait'."
Besides picture books, he has also collaborated on illustrations with American media outlets such as The New York Times, Time magazine, and National Geographic. Serge Bloch currently resides in New York, USA.
Awards: 2005 International Illustrator Association Award; 2005 France Baobab BAOBAB Children's Book Award; 2007 Italy Bologna Children's Book Illustration Award.
summary_zh: 本页为作者塞吉·布罗什的介绍，包括其生平、职业成就、合作媒体及主要获奖记录，右侧配有一张他仰望画作中牛仔帽的照片。
